_bug: EARLIER DRAFT - run-end counter fired after the outage window closed, so the solver happily left low_value_shop dark for all 3 outage hours and reported status=ok. The fixed sliding-window constraint plus the post-solve infeasibility sweep catches this case.
_what_was_wrong: Consecutive-dark was a run-end counter instead of a sliding-window constraint. The MILP now uses pulp.lpSum(x[i,t] for t in window) >= 1 over every contiguous window of size W = max_consecutive_dark + 1, and a post-solve sweep in _collect_feasibility_warnings() demotes any remaining violation to status=infeasible with a human-readable reason.
